catches: New Chase checking customers only; excludes anyone who closed a Chase checking account in the past 90 days or closed one with a negative balance in the last 3 years.
One bonus per account; only one bonus every two years from the last offer enrollment.

steps: Request/receive the Chase college offer code via email.
Open a new Chase Secure Banking account online or in a branch, bringing the offer code and two acceptable forms of ID (plan about an hour in branch).
Complete 10 qualifying transactions within 60 days of account opening — debit card purchases, Zelle transfers, ACH credits, Chase QuickDeposit, or online bill payments.
Bonus of $175 is credited within 15 days after the qualifying transactions complete; keep the account open and unrestricted until payout.
timing: Complete 10 qualifying transactions within 60 days of account opening; bonus arrives within 15 days after completion; account must be open and unrestricted at payout.
when_cash_arrives: Bonus $175. Per official terms: Complete 10 qualifying transactions within 60 days of account opening; bonus arrives within 15 days after completion; account must be open and unrestricted at payout. Earliest realistic: ~16 days (qualifying transactions doable same-day + up to 2-3 weeks).
maximize: Fastest honest path. No direct deposit needed, so qualification can be same-day. Fastest honest path: batch the required debit transactions in one shopping run as soon as the debit card is active (small purchases count; check whether ATM transactions are excluded). After completion, the bank's payout window is fixed.
